name: Silverheart Resonance
descriptionTemplate:
Ramona gains an additional 2.5 Keyflare Regen attribute. Each Affinity level additionally grants Ramona 0.5 Keyflare Regen attribute.
For each point of Keyflare Regen Lv., increase the Base DMG of {Queen's Sword} by 1%, and after playing, gain 0.75 temporary Realm Mastery.
